story.title: A Door to a magical market!
paragraphs_en: One day Rita went to her uncle's house .Her uncle told her,"Do not climb this mountain. Villagers say it is not safe!" The next morning, the girl wondered what was up there? She asked her uncle what was up there? Her uncle said," I do not know". The girl decided to climb the mountain. The next day she woke up at 5am and while her uncle was snoring she took some equipment, water and snacks and stepped out to climb the mountain.

Once she reached the top she was amazed by what she saw. She saw a huge wall with a green arch door with a number 142 painted on it.The wall and its door just stood there staring at her and she was tempted to open it. She walked cautiously towards the door ,took a deep breath and pushed open the door. Suddenly there was a bright light flash and when her eyes slowly adjusted back to normal she was in a different world.

There were all types of foods and colors and people and kids. She said to herself ,"How is this not safe?"She wanted to know about this place so she went to a boy's parent and asked what is this place. The parent said," Welcome. You are the new girl every one is talking about. Let me show you around." Her son said hi and the woman said," Come along my dear child."The little girl was worried but the woman said there is nothing to worry about.

The girl followed her through the crowd, then she saw a small house. Inside it were people who were very happy. The woman said these people are happy because a new guest had arrived in the market .The girl asked who the guest was and the woman smiled and said the guest was her!!! The girl was delighted! One of the ladies served tea and another lady told her about the place and showed her pictures about the place. There was also a small little puppy prancing around happily.

There was a girl who said," Do you want play with me?" Rita said okay and they went to her room.They played for some time and when it was time to go they said bye and then Rita went with the woman to another house.

When she entered the house she saw five men waiting for her on the sofa. The women told Rita to introduce herself. Rita then gave an introduction about herself and the men liked her and said "Wow!" The girl said thank you and she learnt about the people and the places from them. She also asked why the house was so big. The men explained that theirs was a large family and needed a big house.

Then the woman showed her to the next room where there were old people who said welcome in a hoarse voice. They took an old book from a cupboard and showed her magical fruits in the book and told her all about it . They also told her scary stories about the bad witch of the marketplace and how she took over the market and how they bravely fought back. The girl asked granny if the witch would come back but granny said she did not know.

That evening , she said let's take a photo of the whole family. All of them said cheeeeeeeese!!!! and then they said byeee!!! The woman took her back to the magic door and though Rita was sad to leave she stepped back into her world and closed the door and climbed down quickly back to her house.

When she came back her uncle asked," Where were you ??" The girl said I went to play and went swimming . Since I needed to change to swim clothes , I went to the shop and bought a new swim suit and had fun. Her uncle looked at her suspiciously but went on with his work. Rita climbed back to her bed and slept like a log as she was very tired.

She visited the market every day and shared her poems to her new friends. One of their favorites was : " One tree can start a forest , One smile can begin a friendship, One hand can lift a soul, One word can frame the goal. One candle can wipe out darkness , One laugh can conquer gloom, One touch can show you care, One life can make the difference. Be blessed today , Be that one today ."
